notes: U2 replace was only a material change (existing handle is already a metal lever) -> round brass doorknob. U3 mask covered the printed blouse -> v2 mask = pink vest only; dangling 'on its chest' removed from payload.

units.instruction_ref_zh: 将左门的把手替换为一个黄铜圆形门把手。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一个黄铜圆形门把手。
units.reason: Existing handle is a lever handle on a backplate; a round knob is a genuine structural replacement.

units.instruction_ref_zh: 在缝纫者的粉色马甲上加上一枚小白色姓名牌。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一枚小白色姓名牌。
units.reason: Payload had dangling 'on its chest'; mask re-segmented (SAM3 'pink vest') to exclude the printed blouse sleeve and front.
